name: BTL1

cost.note: £399 GBP; converted at ~1.33 GBP/USD (Aug 2026); includes course, labs, and 2 exam attempts

levelNote: Re-based twice. The original note called this "a Centri entry-level course with hands-on labs" and weighted it at entry tier, which did not survive checking the programme: 330+ lessons and 23 browser labs with 100 hours of access across six domains — security fundamentals, phishing analysis, threat intelligence, digital forensics, SIEM and incident response. That correction then overshot to 49, putting it above CCDL1, which examines a broader curriculum over twice the window. The exam is a 24-hour hands-on investigation of a live compromised corporate network answering 20 evidence-derived tasks at a 70% cut: a real assessment, and comfortably above the multiple-choice papers in its column, but the first step in the series rather than the top of it. Exam-only score 38, +9 for the training.
